Render a Quarto dashboard for a study QC snapshot

Source: R/qc_dashboard.R
render_qc_dashboard.Rd

Render a Quarto dashboard for a study QC snapshot

Usage

render_qc_dashboard(
  x,
  output_dir,
  title = NULL,
  quarto = Sys.which("quarto"),
  quiet = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

A bg_qc_inventory returned by collect_qc_inventory().

output_dir

A new or empty directory for the HTML and its downloadable RDS/TSV snapshot. Keep these files together when sharing the dashboard.

title

Optional dashboard title. Defaults to the project name.

quarto

Path to the Quarto executable; defaults to the executable on PATH. Quarto 1.4 or newer is required.

quiet

Suppress Quarto progress output.

Value

Invisibly returns the absolute path to index.html.

Details

Rendering requires optional packages reactable, plotly, htmltools, htmlwidgets, knitr, and rmarkdown. Collection and TSV/RDS export do not require these packages or Quarto. JavaScript and styles are embedded in the HTML; search, filtering, row details, and plots work without a server or network connection. Linked evidence remains in its source location, using paths relative to the dashboard. Moving only the dashboard preserves its displayed snapshot but does not copy upstream reports, logs, or images. No human ratings or analysis decisions are collected.

See also

collect_qc_inventory(), write_qc_inventory()
